plan.name: Selling on Qlozet
plan.commissionNote: commission on each sale, only when you sell
features: No monthly fee and no listing fee
Your own storefront for clothing, fabric and accessories
Bespoke quote requests with the customer's design, styles and measurements attached
A chat with the customer on every bespoke order
Shipping labels and courier pickups from your dashboard
Verified badge once your business is approved
A business assistant and a weekly digest of what changed

notes.title: When you get paid
notes.text: Earnings from an order become available 14 days after the customer pays. Withdraw to your bank whenever you like. For bespoke work, the deposit and the balance each follow that 14-day schedule from the day they're paid.

notes.title: What's taken from a sale
notes.text: The commission and any payment or tax charges are itemised on every order in your dashboard, so you always see what you earn before you ship.

notes.title: Running a larger brand?
notes.text: If you sell at volume or across several stores, talk to us about onboarding and support.
